summary: FINAL RETEST of iteration-6/7 HIGH bug (inline '+ Add Category' auto-select in EmployeeFormModal). ALL 3 REQUIRED SCENARIOS PASS. The fix (SelectValue children reading label from categories cache + onCategorySelect ignoring empty '' values + optimistic setQueryData) resolves the bug on both Site Engineer and Admin flows, and regression (picking existing category + edit modal showing saved category) still works. Bug is CLOSED.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix approach is sound and matches iteration-7 recommendation: SelectValue children decouples the trigger label from Radix's internal item registry so it works even when SelectItems for the new category aren't mounted yet. The `if (!v) return;` guard in onCategorySelect correctly prevents Radix's empty-value onValueChange from wiping form.category_id when the category modal closes.
Optimistic qc.setQueryData in EmployeeCategoryFormModal is a nice UX touch — the new option shows up instantly if user reopens the dropdown before the invalidateQueries refetch.
